_doc: Read by gate 2b of the door (02-rig.py:309-324). lock-fleets (owner, 2026-09-15) starts each unit and each move itself, from the launch fleet.yaml states, and runs the lock's own harness (mcgyvr/fleet/harness.py) on the rig, never the serving harness, so it is not held to that harness's markers. The reusable bodies are _unit.sh and _move.sh; each use's numbered wrappers sit in a folder of their own, generated by records/measurements/lock-fleets/plan.py.
